SPL/THD/IMP evidence cites mostly header rows, not enough data rows.
ST appears to be a reference group but is not handled clearly.
requiredUserQuestions: Confirm the changed condition is VP mold 7 with +0.3 mm versus normal VP?
correctionPlan: Set baseline to Normal VP and changed condition to Test VP.
Normalize changed factor to VP mold 7 +0.3 mm test if confirmed by source context.
Group SPL, THD, IMP, and FO as outcomes under one validation case.
Remove bogus FO row-derived statistics and use actual averages/data only.
Cite header plus representative data and average rows for each outcome.
